entries.33ca06e41f4c5338: As its long-term vision it adopts “Yokuhakobu,” and in March 2026 it formulated a new medium-term management plan, “Ashitamo Genki” (plan period: April 2026 to March 2029). By business, the policy is: in the ocean shipping business, to operate the Handy fleet that “carries well” over the long term; in the warehousing and transport business, to keep honing its practical strength while creating “tomorrow” through new concepts; and in the real estate business, to support the business foundation and carry the lives of Katsudoki into the future.
